common.save.description: Button: save the current form or changes.

common.cancel.description: Button: close a form or dialog without saving.

common.edit.description: Button: open an item for editing.

common.delete.description: Button: delete an item (asks to confirm first).

common.search.description: Placeholder and label for a search box.

common.empty.description: Shown when a list or table has no items.

common.error.description: Generic error message when a request fails.

common.retry.description: Button: repeat a request that failed.

common.offline.description: Banner shown when the device has no connection.

common.syncPending.message: {count, plural, one {# change waiting to sync} other {# changes waiting to sync}}
common.syncPending.description: Sync status: number of changes saved on this device but not yet uploaded. {count} is a number.

common.back.description: Button or link: go to the previous screen.

common.next.description: Button: go to the next step.

common.close.description: Button: close a dialog or panel.

common.active.description: Status badge: active record or account.

common.inactive.description: Status badge: inactive or archived record.

common.pending.description: Status badge: waiting for approval or completion.

common.required.description: Validation error shown when a required form field is empty.

common.optional.description: Helper label or hint marking a non-required form field.

common.selectOption.description: Placeholder text inside a dropdown select control.

common.name.description: Generic form label for a record name.

common.notes.description: Generic form label for multi-line notes or remarks.

common.enabled.description: Toggle or status label indicating a feature is switched on.

common.disabled.description: Toggle or status label indicating a feature is switched off.

common.skipToContent.description: Skip navigation link for keyboard and screen reader users.

common.navigationMenu.description: Accessible title for the mobile navigation drawer.

common.mainNavigation.description: Accessible label for the primary sidebar navigation landmark.

common.openMenu.description: Button label: open the mobile navigation drawer.

common.closeMenu.description: Button label: close the mobile navigation drawer.

common.notifications.description: Accessible region label for toast notifications.

common.closeNotification.description: Button label: dismiss a toast notification.

common.demoNotice.message: Demo data. Nothing on this screen is real.
common.demoNotice.description: Banner notice shown on screens displaying mock prototype data.

common.syncSynced.description: Sync status: all local changes are synced with the server.

common.syncPendingGeneric.description: Sync status: unsynced local changes exist without a specific count.

common.syncSyncing.description: Sync status: local changes are currently being uploaded.

common.syncConflict.message: {count, plural, one {# sync conflict} other {# sync conflicts}}
common.syncConflict.description: Sync status: number of local changes with server conflicts. {count} is a number.

common.syncConflictGeneric.description: Sync status: at least one sync conflict needs review without a count.

common.syncOffline.description: Sync status: compact label when the device has no network connection.

common.syncOfflinePending.description: Sync status: offline with queued local changes. {count} is a number.

common.syncError.description: Sync status: uploading local changes failed.

common.syncLastSynced.description: Sync status secondary text showing when data last synced. {time} is a formatted timestamp.

common.pagination.description: Accessible landmark label for table and list pagination controls.

common.paginationRange.description: Table pagination summary showing the visible item range and total count.

common.paginationPageOf.description: Table pagination summary showing the current page and total pages.

common.rowsPerPage.description: Label for the page size selector in table pagination.

common.firstPage.description: Button label: jump to the first page of a table.

common.previousPage.description: Button label: go to the previous page of a table.

common.nextPage.description: Button label: go to the next page of a table.

common.lastPage.description: Button label: jump to the last page of a table.

common.pageSizeOption.description: Formatted numeric option inside the rows-per-page selector. {count} is a number.

term.learner.description: Terminology: one person who studies here. Institution types rename it (e.g. Child, Student, Trainee).

term.learners.description: Terminology: plural of term.learner, used in menus and headings.

term.teacher.description: Terminology: a person who teaches (e.g. Lecturer, Trainer, Instructor).

term.class.description: Terminology: a teaching group (e.g. Group, Course, Batch, Cohort).

term.guardian.description: Terminology: a parent or guardian responsible for a learner.
